entries.sourceReference: Authored crossover movement and choreography based on the stated version and equipment; not copied official animation and not certified frame-for-frame canon. Simple/air/ledge actions follow the actual simple profile; charge/special use the secondary profile.

normalization.method: Connected-alpha whole-pose segmentation; one body calibration, nearest-neighbor pixel scale and render factor per native source. Explicit real corrective rows inserted without synthesizing anatomy.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; ledge attachment uses separately measured real native palms.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; original PNGs archived unchanged.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default; turn begins facing left, passes two native rear-three-quarter bodies and ends facing right.
visualValidation.outfit: HL2 orange/charcoal HEV MkV, brown hair/goatee, black glasses and full gloves.
visualValidation.weapons: Simple and aerial/ledge get-up use crowbar. Secondary charge/special uses orange Gravity Gun with native captive metal prop only before release; separate32 super uses blue Citadel gun. Movement/defense/hanging hands free.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Original adapted crossover choreography; no certified official1:1 animation or exported game frames.
Runtime facing mirrors the native source, including costume asymmetry.
Ledge-only source uses a head-to-sole hanging reference with raised hands excluded; this is not certified as an upright standing anatomy reference.
